Class WindModel

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.water.WindModel

  • Constructor Details

    • WindModel

      public WindModel(long seed, float changeSpeed, float strengthVariation, float baseAmplitude)
      Creates deterministic wind variation and initializes its current values at time zero.
      Parameters:
      seed - seed for the noise sequence
      changeSpeed - positive rate at which the noise is sampled
      strengthVariation - relative amplitude variation in [0, 1]
      baseAmplitude - baseline wave amplitude in world units; nonnegative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a setting is non-finite or outside its allowed range

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(float tpf)
      Advances the deterministic wind state.
      Parameters:
      tpf - elapsed time in seconds; must be finite and nonnegative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if tpf is negative or non-finite
